title: Form rejected your photo

scenes.voice_hi: फॉर्म ने फोटो फिर रिजेक्ट कर दी?
scenes.say_hi: Form ne photo phir reject kar di?

scenes.label: THE PROBLEM
scenes.voice: It wants fifty K B. Yours is two point four M B.
scenes.say: It wants 50 KB. Yours is 2.4 MB.
scenes.voice_hi: उसे चाहिए पचास के बी। आपकी है दो पॉइंट चार एम बी।
scenes.say_hi: Use chahiye 50 KB. Aapki hai 2.4 MB.

scenes.label: 10 SECOND FIX
scenes.voice: Open I love documents dot A I.
scenes.voice_hi: आई लव डॉक्यूमेंट्स डॉट ए आई खोलो।

scenes.label: ACCEPTED
scenes.voice_hi: फिर से अपलोड करो। हो गया।
scenes.say_hi: Phir se upload karo. Ho gaya.

scenes.label: FREE
scenes.voice: No app. No sign up. Free.
scenes.voice_hi: ना ऐप। ना साइन अप। बिल्कुल फ्री।
scenes.say_hi: Na app. Na sign-up. Bilkul free.

scenes.screen: Save this for your next form
scenes.voice: Save this. Your next form will thank you.
scenes.say: Save this. Your next form will thank you.
scenes.voice_hi: इसे सेव कर लो। अगले फॉर्म में काम आएगा।
scenes.say_hi: Ise save kar lo. Agle form mein kaam aayega.

caption:
Form ne photo reject kar di? 10 second ka fix.
Save this for your next form. Comment FORM for the link.
